notes.title: [BREAKING NEWS] Fire at the offices of Star Industries S.L.
notes.content:
StarOS v.1.1 Patch (Auto-Downloader)
#############

-Visual errors fix.
-Steam screenshots fix.
-Achievements fixes.

-You can now return to the main menu by pressing ESC during a game.
-The spacecraft has updated its route on teletext.
-Doggy has gone to look for the rest of the children.
-Authorities have captured the kidnapper.
-Improvements in diagnostic submission.
-Now you can pray in the church.
-We have improved Astro's AI.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Archive record - 1973/10/30]

We have received news from the developer of the famous computer software "StarOS".
The offices of Star Industries S.L. burned down this morning, for the moment we do not know the reasons.

The 47 deceased have been recognized, all of them were recently hired workers.

The whereabouts of the main executives of the company, who were already under police investigation for allegedly stealing data from third party computers, are unknown.
Also missing is a group of 5 agents led by Erom Yarp, all of whom were involved in the investigation of the events.

The FBI has also completely banned the distribution and use of any software related to Star Industries S.L.

Beth Ringind (New Post Times)

notes.title: A revolutionary product!
notes.content:
[u][b][Archive record - 1973/06/21][/b][/u]


[h2]Star Industries S.L plans to open new headquarters and launch a revolutionary product during the next few weeks.[/h2]

The leading computer company is finalizing the development of a powerful tool.
According to the latest press conference they have said it will set precedents in the software and operating systems industry.

The beginning of this decade of the 70s has been promising and we are already seeing risky bets for the computers of large companies and offices.

What will Star Industries have to offer us for our home computers?

Thanks for reading!
Beth Ringind (New Post Times)
